_readme: This file decides WHICH roles the tracker lists. Every pattern is a case-insensitive regular expression tested against the job TITLE. Edit here to widen or narrow the list; no Python changes needed. Run `python3 -m pytest tests/test_roles.py` after editing. 'engineering' marks titles that are engineering jobs on a growth or marketing team; they are only listed when they match the GTM Engineering family.
adjacent: \b(?:solutions? (?:engineer\w*|architect\w*|consultant)|sales engineer\w*|forward[- ]deployed|technical account manage\w*|customer success|customer support|customer experience|customer operations|support specialist|implementation|partner(?:ship)?s?|alliances|public sector|analyst relations|communications|public relations|\bpr\b)\b

families.label: Sales
families.pattern: \b(?:account executive|\bae\b|\bsdr\b|\bbdr\b|sales development|business development rep\w*|sales rep\w*|inside sales|sales associate|sales manager|sales consultant|sales specialist)\b

families.label: Growth Marketing
families.pattern: \b(?:growth market\w*|marketing growth|growth (?:&|and) marketing|demand gen\w*|lead gen\w*|performance market\w*|lifecycle market\w*|acquisition market\w*|user acquisition|paid (?:social|media|search|acquisition)|\bseo\b|\bsem\b|crm marketing|email marketing|digital marketing)\b

levels.new_grad: \b(?:new[- ]grad(?:uate)?s?|recent grad(?:uate)?s?|university grad(?:uate)?s?|college grad(?:uate)?s?|early[- ]career|early in career|campus hire|graduate (?:program|programme|scheme|rotation\w*)|rotational (?:program|associate|analyst)|graduate(?! (?:school|studies|admissions|student|medical|nurse)))\b
